- always check virtual envrionment "antigravitytest-env" after startup, if not activated or in other virtual environment, run
```
Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Proces; ./antigravitytest-env/Scripts/Activate.ps1;
```
to activate "antigravitytest-env"
- while writing any code/rules/skills/workflows, use english only
